answer: Issuance is tied to graded-work history, so a new identity earns almost nothing until 14 epochs of honest answers are on record. Cloning 220 keys multiplies the waiting, not the payout, and any junk verdict resets the clock to zero. The ember is the check that cannot be faked, the prism is the price the attacker pays, and the ivory is the record that outlives the epoch.
